The PIB gate kept nothing out of 47 releases, which is the normal and correct outcome. Separately, the DGTR filed THREE trade-remedy initiations today - clavulanic acid (anti-dumping, China and the EU), copper tubes and pipes (countervailing, Malaysia/Thailand/Vietnam) and aluminium extrusion profiles (suo-moto anti-dumping, four countries) - and all three are unresearchable from this sandbox because www.dgtr.gov.in is blocked at the network policy. Under the PLAYBOOK's TRADE rule (added after the OCCL miss) the finding itself must be read before any name is named. So the honest verdict on all three is UNKNOWN, carried forward, with the blocked host named. This is the single highest-value thing to unblock for this routine: a trade-remedy initiation names the domestic industry that asked for it, which is the most direct 'who gains' signal the government lane ever produces.

orderbook_jumps_table.detail:
No signals row at yoy_pct >= 50 was missing from the ledger, so the day's work was the queue of re-checks that the 2026-11-19 run carried forward - companies that had since stated a NEWER order book. All four were cleared, plus a fifth found today:

1. **ASTRA MICROWAVE (532493) - NOT A JUMP -> CONFIRMED.** This is the find of the run. Both sides were read from the quarterly results notes themselves: Group+JV order book **Rs 4,707.59 cr as at 30-Sep-2026** (Q2 FY27 board outcome, BSE 12-Nov-2026, note 4 to the consolidated results; standalone note 3 gives Rs 3,937.00 cr) against **Rs 2,208.90 cr as at 30-Sep-2025** (Q2 FY26 results, BSE 13-Nov-2025, note 4; standalone Rs 1,908.78 cr) = **+113.1% consolidated, +106.3% standalone**. It is intake, not a definition change: H1 FY27 orders booked Rs 2,647.34 cr against Rs 390.92 cr in H1 FY26, both from the same notes. The June pair stays below the bar (Rs 2,849.09 cr vs Rs 2,236.19 cr = +27.4%, Q1 filings re-read this run from NSE), and the BSE announcement list for Aug-Nov 2026 was read to confirm no filing in between states a book, so the TRIGGER is 12-Nov-2026. Market cap Rs 15,477 cr puts it far outside the band, so table row only - no card.

2. **DILIP BUILDCON (540047) - latest corrected.** The filed figure is **Rs 33,081 cr as of 30-Sep-2026** (Q2 FY27 press release, BSE 12-Nov-2026: 'a record Rs 33,081 crore, up 19% from Rs 27,691 crore as of June 30, 2026'), against Rs 18,610 cr at 30-Sep-2025 = +77.8%. The screen's Rs 34,000 cr is management's rounded number spoken in the 19-Nov analyst-meet transcript. Trigger unchanged (10-Feb-2026).

3. **ENVIRO INFRA (544290) - latest moved to a dated figure.** Rs 6,778.2 cr as of 30-Sep-2026 from the Q2 FY27 press release (BSE 05-Nov-2026), which splits it - Water & Wastewater Rs 34,387 mn (EPC 21,056 + HAM 3,463 + O&M 9,867), renewables Rs 33,395 mn - rather than the 'as on date' figure in the 12-Nov transcript the screen used. The two agree. Renewables are now ~49% of the book against nil two years ago; that caveat was strengthened in the row.

4. **JASH ENGINEERING (544402) - re-checked, verdict unchanged.** Rs 944 cr consolidated as on 1-Oct-2026 read from the NSE letter of 09-Oct-2026 (India Rs 313 cr, outside India Rs 631 cr). Against the Rs 863 cr at 1-Sep-2025 and Rs 890 cr at 1-Nov-2025 already in the row's walk that is +6% to +9%. Still NOT A JUMP.

5. **DEE DEVELOPMENT (544198) - confirmed again, and a date error in the screen found.** Today's Q2/H1 FY27 transcript states the Sep-26 pair in the company's own words ('Rs. 2,531 crores as of 30th September 2026, up 94% from Rs. 1,308 crores a year earlier') and a newer book of **Rs 2,586 cr as of 31 OCTOBER 2026**. orderbook_signals.json carries that Rs 2,586 cr with as_on 2026-09-30, which is wrong. The ledger keeps the like-for-like September pair as `latest` because no 31-Oct-2025 figure has been read to pair the October book with.

per_idea.note: The biggest update of the day. A press release on the Copper Clad Laminate project (filed 15:53, revised 16:22-16:36 IST) puts THREE-YEAR PROJECTIONS on the record for the first time: consolidated revenue ~Rs 1,414 cr FY27 -> Rs 2,434 cr FY28 -> Rs 3,914 cr FY29, EBITDA ~Rs 180 cr -> Rs 399 cr -> Rs 775 cr, margins 12.7% -> 16.4% -> 19.8%, with CCL at Rs 49.5 cr / Rs 653.4 cr / Rs 2,004.75 cr of that at a ~25.9% EBITDA margin. Five lines of ~15.84 lakh sheets each (79.2 lakh total), commissioned Feb-2027 through Jun-2028, about Rs 338 cr of investment over three years, approved under the Government's Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme with a capex subsidy, and customer commitments covering 'nearly 50%' of planned capacity (not quantified in rupees). GUIDANCE LINE REWRITTEN. Logged with the caveat the reader needs: FY29 revenue is 3.6x FY26's Rs 1,080 cr and about half of it comes from a product whose first line starts in February 2027.

Fresh LOI dated 25-Nov-2026 from Sterlite Grid 5 for the 400 kV D/C Xeldom-Narendra line in Goa and Karnataka: Rs 272 cr excluding GST headline, of which **Rs 175.67 cr is incremental**, 18 months. It is not a new award - it re-prices and extends the EPC contract Sterlite Power gave Jyoti in September 2022, whose infra business passed to Sterlite Grid 5 under the NCLT order of 05-Sep-2024. The press release headlines the gross number; both filings were opened and logged separately so the Rs 96.33 cr gap between headline and increment is on the card.

Q2/H1 FY27 call transcript. Q2 revenue Rs 293 cr (+8.5%), EBITDA Rs 58.9 cr (+33.7%) at a 20.1% margin against 16.3%, PAT Rs 23.5 cr (+31.8%); H1 revenue Rs 587.4 cr (+19%), EBITDA Rs 108.6 cr (+35.9%), PAT Rs 39.5 cr (+27.8%). Order book Rs 2,531 cr at Sep-26 (+94% YoY), Rs 2,586 cr at 31-Oct. H1 inflow Rs 1,179 cr (+97%), ~60% of the Rs 2,000 cr annual guidance. Verdict GOOD. The qualifier that matters: ~45% of H1 execution was job work on customer-supplied material, which held the reported top line back. Nuclear piping JV at an advanced stage, closure expected by end FY27. Guidance unchanged.

Rs 55.63 cr including taxes from Utkal Alumina International for 108 BTAPM1 and BVCM wagons, by 30-Sep-2027. Routine scale for a Rs 4,671 cr wagon builder and well under 10% of a year's sales. Guidance unchanged.

Rs 4.11 cr from Integral Coach Factory, Chennai for 53 coach sets of seats by 31-Dec-2027 - about 0.6% of the 'around Rs 700 crores' FY27 turnover management guided to. Payment terms stated in the filing (80% on inspection, 20% plus installation after acceptance). Guidance unchanged.

GK Energy BESS Private Limited incorporated 25-Nov-2026, the first of the five wholly owned subsidiaries the board approved on 29-Oct. Wide objects (storage, battery manufacturing and recycling, green hydrogen, trading, EPC) but no investment amount, plan or timeline, so nothing enters the model. Guidance unchanged.

Postal-ballot results and scrutinizer's report: an authorised-capital increase and the issuance of BONUS EQUITY SHARES both passed, 99.99% of votes polled in favour, 72.68% of outstanding shares voting. The ratio is not stated in this document. The filing also pins promoter and promoter-group holding at 1,81,37,000 of 2,49,98,000 shares = 72.55%. Guidance unchanged.
Two investor-meet intimations of 25-Nov, the only unlogged item from yesterday on any card. Housekeeping, logged so the filing trail has no gap. Guidance unchanged.

A day where the honest answer in two of the three lanes was 'nothing', and the real work was in the order-book ledger and the updates sweep.

**Lane one: the gate kept nothing, and a blocked host cost us three live signals.** The PIB read scanned 47 releases and kept 0 - normal, and correct. But the government-sources feed caught THREE DGTR trade-remedy initiations filed today: anti-dumping on clavulanic acid / potassium clavulanate from China and the EU, countervailing duty on copper tubes and pipes from Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam, and a SUO-MOTO anti-dumping investigation into aluminium extrusion profiles from four countries. These are exactly the category the PLAYBOOK added after the OCCL miss, and a trade-remedy initiation is the most direct 'who gains' document the government lane ever produces because it names the domestic industry that petitioned. All three are UNKNOWN tonight: www.dgtr.gov.in is refused by this sandbox's network policy, no listed company filed anything about them with BSE today, and the rule against naming a beneficiary on a hunch held. Unblocking dgtr.gov.in is the highest-value change the owner could make to this routine.

**Lane two: 36 strong signals, none real.** The WPI panel is seven months stale (April 2026) and the wpi step is the only one that fails on the Actions runner too, so it is a genuinely missing feed - the same finding as yesterday, now a week old. It drives the strength score of almost every group in the top ten. Read against the prints that are actually from today, the ranking inverts: crude -16.9% in a month, silver -25.5%, gold -9.9%, aluminium -6.5%, polypropylene -12.9%, styrene -19.9%, naphtha -21.4%. The only fresh up-moves are Henry Hub gas, US Class III milk and CBOT rough rice - American prints with no documented Indian pass-through.

**Lane three published one name, and it is a name with eleven red flags.** Cubex Tubings (BSE 526027, Rs 291 cr) filed an investor presentation at 17:08 showing Q2 FY27 PAT of Rs 4.57 cr at an 8.62% EBITDA margin against 2.17% a year earlier, and a Rs 87 cr vacuum-induction-melting project fully funded by a Rs 75 cr warrant issue approved at the EGM on 6-Nov. The business is genuinely hard to replicate - 47 years old, five India-first copper and cupronickel grades, approvals from NPCIL, DAE, Engineers India, Naval DQA and the Ordnance Factory - and the furnace opens nickel superalloys and titanium, which India imports. The card is published at LOW-TO-MEDIUM confidence because everything else about it argues for caution, and all of it is written in: the presentation's own year-on-year column is mislabelled (it compares Q2 FY27 with Q1 FY27 - against BSE's detailed results the real YoY is revenue +12.6%, PAT +162.6%); both exchanges raised observations that forced a corrigendum to the EGM notice supplying disclosures the original notice lacked; the warrants are 26% below market with the promoter group taking 33.9 lakh of 50 lakh and going from 44.42% to 50.48%; two non-promoter allottees share the same two ultimate beneficial owners and sit just under 5% each; FY26 PAT of Rs 7.45 cr was carried by Rs 8.22 cr of other income; note 31 of the accounts says receivable and payable balances are subject to confirmation from the parties; the order book is 0.31x a year's sales; and median turnover is about Rs 11 lakh a day in a T-group scrip already up 165% in three months. Revenue is flat - the entire step-up is one quarter of margin, and Q3 decides whether it is a mix shift or an artefact.

Three other order filings were opened and all three failed the same measured test - Walchandnagar's Rs 18.46 cr launcher order at 5.2% of a trailing year's sales, JD Cables' Rs 15.89 cr at 4.4%, EMS's Rs 25.96 cr NHAI fee-collection award at 4.8%. All in the under-10% bucket that the 1,245-filing study found has no edge.

**The order-book ledger is where the run earned its keep.** The queue of re-checks carried forward since 2026-11-19 was cleared, and one row flipped: ASTRA MICROWAVE goes from NOT A JUMP to CONFIRMED on a group-and-JV order book of Rs 4,707.59 cr at 30-Sep-2026 against Rs 2,208.90 cr a year earlier, +113.1%, both read from the quarterly results notes themselves, driven by H1 intake of Rs 2,647.34 cr against Rs 390.92 cr. At Rs 15,477 cr of market capitalisation it is far outside the band, so it is a table row and not a card - but the table is now right. Dilip Buildcon's latest was corrected from the transcript's rounded Rs 34,000 cr to the filed Rs 33,081 cr, Enviro Infra's moved to a dated and segment-split Rs 6,778.2 cr, Jash stays NOT A JUMP on a newly read Rs 944 cr, and a date error in the screen was found on DEE Development.

**The updates sweep found the day's most consequential filing, and it was not on a candidate list.** Ratnaveer Precision put three-year projections on the record for the first time - consolidated revenue Rs 1,414 cr FY27 to Rs 3,914 cr FY29, EBITDA Rs 180 cr to Rs 775 cr - with the Copper Clad Laminate plant (five lines, 79.2 lakh sheets, Rs 338 cr, ECMS-approved) carrying almost all of it. The guidance line on that card was rewritten. Jyoti Structures' Rs 272 cr LOI turned out to be Rs 175.67 cr of new work on a 2022 contract. Nine updates across eight cards, one guidance change. One failure to report, not a quiet day: Viviana filed what its filename calls an L1-stage intimation on a PGVCL tender and the document could not be opened from this sandbox - carried to the next run rather than guessed at.
data_problems: **www.dgtr.gov.in is refused by this sandbox's network policy** (curl: 403 at the agent proxy, 'no rule or network setting allows this host'; WebFetch: ENOTFOUND). This cost lane one three live trade-remedy initiations today - clavulanic acid, copper tubes and pipes, and a suo-moto case on aluminium extrusion profiles - every one of which names the petitioning domestic industry in its notice. Of everything on this list, this is the one worth fixing: the PLAYBOOK's own TRADE rule (written after OCCL rose 43% while the scan showed it as a volume spike) cannot be followed without this host.

**WPI panel seven months stale (April 2026).** wpi.py failed here (eaindustry.nic.in refused at the proxy) AND is the only failed step on the ideas-feeds Action runner, which reaches it on good days. This is a genuinely missing feed, not a sandbox block, and it is the single reason 36 of 53 commodity groups show a 'strong' signal that today's prices contradict. It has now failed on the runner for at least two consecutive days. Needs the owner's attention.

**Trade panel two months stale (September 2026).** tradestat.commerce.gov.in refused here and on the Action's hosts_blocked list. docs/ideas/trade/** unchanged. Monthly by nature, but it is the second of the two panels that set the commodity strength score, so between them the ranking is built on April and September data.

**pib.gov.in unreachable from the sandbox**, so this run's own govt.py could not read 26-Nov or 25-Nov and left govt.json untouched (it printed 'today could not be read; govt.json LEFT UNCHANGED' and marked both days unread). The Action's 18:56 IST read was used instead - 47 releases scanned, 0 kept. docs/ideas/govt_history.json was restored to the Action's version with `git checkout --` on that one path, because this run's copy would have overwritten the Action's successful read of those two days with 'unread'.

**BSE's AttachLive can serve a 730-byte error page for older attachments; AttachHis serves the same file in full.** Measured on Astra Microwave's November-2025 results and press release: AttachLive returned a one-page PDF reading 'Error / This page can't be displayed / Contact support', AttachHis returned 2.0 MB and 1.1 MB documents. Any reader that trusts a 200 response without checking the size will silently read nothing. This run checks every download and retries on AttachHis.

**orderbook_signals.json quotes Rs 34,000 cr for Dilip Buildcon's Sep-2026 order book; the filed figure is Rs 33,081 cr.** The screen took management's rounded number from the 19-Nov-2026 analyst-meet transcript. The Q2 FY27 press release of 12-Nov-2026 says 'a record Rs 33,081 crore'. Corrected in orderbook_jumps.json.

**orderbook_signals.json dates DEE Development's Rs 2,586 cr order book to 2026-09-30; it is the 31-OCTOBER-2026 book.** Today's Q2 transcript states both: Rs 2,531 cr as of 30-Sep-2026 and Rs 2,586 cr as of 31-Oct-2026 after Rs 148 cr of October inflow. The ledger keeps the September pair because no 31-Oct-2025 figure has been read to pair the October book against.

**scan.py's TRADE category produced a false positive on Cubex Tubings.** The filing is an investor presentation; the only string in the 31-page PDF that matches the TRADE keyword set is 'BIS IS 154', a product standard on the credentials slide. No anti-dumping, countervailing, safeguard, DGTR, MIP or quality-control-order text appears anywhere in it (searched explicitly). The candidate was still worth researching on its results and capex, but the TRADE flag is noise - the keyword list probably needs 'quality control order' to require the full phrase rather than matching 'BIS'.

**Viviana Power Tech's 26-Nov NSE filing could not be opened.** The queue row's filename is 'VIVIANA__Intimation_of_L1_Stage_Successful_bidder_PGVCL.pdf' on nsearchives.nseindia.in, which this sandbox refuses; the .com substitution that works for most NSE files returns NSE's 'file you are trying to access doesn't appear to exist' page for this one (3,814 bytes, two pages). Viviana is NSE-only (no BSE scrip), so there is no second copy. No update was written. If the filename is accurate this is an L1 position on a Paschim Gujarat Vij Company tender and is material to a card in the govt lane.

**updates.py was not run, by choice, and the --selftest line the prompt asks for was therefore not produced.** www.nseindia.com answers 403 from NSE itself in this sandbox and updates.py does not exit 3 on that; yesterday's run measured it degrading every idea's status to SUSPECT mid-write. The Action's queue (19:42 IST, status complete on all 93 ideas, second_reader_misses 0) was used unmodified. Either the exit-3 path has stopped triggering or it does not cover a 403 from NSE; flagged for the owner for the second day running, scripts untouched per the run's instructions.

**updates_queue.json reports one second-reader problem: 'BSE daily list 2026-11-26 incomplete'.** second_reader_misses is 0, so nothing was found that the per-company reads had missed, but the whole-market BSE day list the second reader re-reads was itself short for today. Stated rather than treated as a clean sweep.

**Ten of twelve india_spot sources failed from the sandbox** (metalbook, ibja, rubber, sugar, fuel, guidechem, cai, spices, te, and minsteel via steel.gov.in); nmdc, minsteel-from-file and moil worked. All failures kept their previous rows, 0 history rows were appended, and india_history.json.gz WAS rebuilt (277 series, 81,216 dated points). nmdc_history.json and moil_history.json changed only in their build timestamp - no new price letters.

**spot.py fetched nothing** (0 commodities; westmetall.com and markets.businessinsider.com both refused), so spot.json and spot_series.json were left unchanged and every spot row in signals.json is the Action's, stamped 19:16 IST today. Correct keep-previous behaviour, but no spot price in this run was fetched by the routine itself.

**minsteel.py could not list steel.gov.in**, so docs/ideas/minsteel_mumbai.json is unchanged; the Ministry of Steel series in signals.json is still the committed one and lags 2-3 months by nature. Say which month when quoting it.

**Two of nine government sources did not read today on the Action runner either**: egazette.gov.in timed out (last OK 25-Nov) and dgft.gov.in answered 403 (last OK 24-Nov). rbi, cerc, dgtr, ministries, coal, mopng and dea all read.

**forum.valuepickr.com and cdn.syndication.twimg.com are both refused by this sandbox** (curl returns nothing; WebFetch ENOTFOUND for twimg). The X and ValuePickr sweeps ran on WebSearch titles and snippets only: no post body was read, no forum page was read, and post counts and dates are recorded as unknown. 'Could not read' is not 'nothing there' - though for Cubex the absence of a dedicated ValuePickr thread is itself a real search result.

**This run's own scan read is an evening read.** 518 of BSE's own 518 rows for 26-Nov-2026, so not capped - better than the Action's 19:18 IST read of 493 of 494 - but taken at 19:50 IST, so any filing made after that is not in it.

**Johnsoncab Electricals (545021, Rs 267 cr) was a candidate whose half-yearly results filing was NOT opened.** It scored 4.0 on two RESULT signals with no order, capex or rating trigger alongside, and the four names ahead of it used the run's reading time. Recorded as not read rather than as nothing there, and carried forward.
